diagnosis_summary: Affected Financial Account List revisions filter to children when AccountId identifies a parent. When no parent is supplied, the condition `topLevelOnly || !parentAccountId.HasValue` always filters to accounts whose ParentAccountId is null, so the root Obsidian list cannot present a flat all-account reorder list when TopLevel is false. Commit 409f2a0 removes the always-true no-parent term and restores the legacy no-parameter all-account mode. The source change directly addresses the diagnosed branch and is the exact fixed revision; release-package inclusion remains independently verifiable.
workaround_summaries: For builds that do not include commit 409f2a0 or an equivalent release fix, manage ordering within each parent-specific account list and verify the resulting public giving presentation in staging. Do not treat the root Obsidian list as a complete flattened account hierarchy or move parent accounts under the assumption that omitted children will follow its order.

verification_playbook.goal: Determine whether the instance has child financial accounts that the Obsidian root reorder list cannot display.
prerequisites: Know the exact installed Rock version or build ancestry.
Have read-only access to aggregate FinancialAccount hierarchy counts.

steps.title: Check the installed list behavior
steps.instructions: Determine whether the installed FinancialAccountList implementation still applies the root-only filter whenever AccountId is absent.
steps.expected_if_affected: The unscoped branch filters ParentAccountId to null regardless of the TopLevel value.
steps.expected_if_unaffected: The installed build exposes an explicit, verified all-account branch or otherwise includes child accounts in the intended reorder operation.

steps.title: Count hierarchy exposure
steps.instructions: Return aggregate counts only. Do not return account IDs, names, balances, or transaction data.
steps.probe: SELECT COUNT(*) AS AccountCount, SUM(CASE WHEN [ParentAccountId] IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ChildAccountCount, SUM(CASE WHEN [ParentAccountId] IS NOT NULL AND [IsActive] = 1 AND [IsPublic] = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ActivePublicChildAccountCount FROM [FinancialAccount]
steps.expected_if_affected: ChildAccountCount is greater than zero and the installed list source has the root-only filter; active public children make the public ordering impact more immediate.
steps.expected_if_unaffected: ChildAccountCount is zero, or the installed list source has a verified all-account path. A zero count removes current data exposure but does not change the code behavior.
evidence_to_record: aggregate active public child account count

steps.title: Compare the hierarchy with the root list
steps.instructions: Open the account hierarchy and root account list without dragging, saving, or editing. Record only whether known child rows are absent from the root reorder surface.
steps.expected_if_affected: Child accounts exist in the hierarchy but are absent from the root reorder list.
steps.expected_if_unaffected: The intended child accounts are present in the reorder surface or the instance has no child accounts.
evidence_to_record: child accounts exist yes or no
child rows absent from root list yes or no

limitations: The playbook confirms applicability but does not test a reorder because dragging accounts changes production ordering.
A staging reorder is still needed to validate how a specific Giving block renders customized account selections.

context.scope: Obsidian Financial Account List used to reorder a hierarchy containing child accounts
reviewed FinancialAccountList source when child accounts exist
exact Financial Account List source revision; release-package inclusion remains independently verifiable
